targets.authors: Narayan, A. J., Ghosh Ippen, C., Harris, W. W., & Lieberman, A. F.
targets.title: Assessing angels in the nursery: A pilot study of childhood memories of benevolent caregiving as protective influences.
targets.evidence_quote: This replication study examined protective effects of positive childhood memories with caregivers (“angels in the nursery”) against lifespan and intergenerational transmission of trauma.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract reports protective associations but neither describes what the original pilot found nor explicitly compares current results with that original. Positive current results alone do not establish replication success.

reasoning: The abstract explicitly describes a new-sample replication. The uniquely fitting empirical reference is the 2017 angels-interview pilot of benevolent caregiving as protective influences. The 2008 interview supplies a measure, the 2005 angels paper introduces the construct, and the 2018 BCE-scale paper uses a different measure; these are not selected as targets. Target identity is inferred from description and remains less certain than full-text identification. Only abstract and references were available after publisher, OpenAlex, Unpaywall and title-search routes; the publisher PDF route returned HTML. Outcome comparison is unavailable.
